answer: Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 123 aliases, and each one needs its own funded karst account. Deposits are visible in gale, and raven reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 55% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The attacker spends 111 dollars and 8 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
